scope: Read-only resource and saved-evidence audit, no scientific training

code_provenance.status: INITIAL and WARMED contain the Python stdin bodies actually executed; file dispatcher added afterwards and not executed
code_provenance.timestamp_note: Per-command wall durations were returned by tools; exact start timestamps were not captured. No timestamp fabricated.
code_provenance.reproducibility_limit: Timing is a short local microbenchmark, not a hardware throughput guarantee. WARMED did not set a random seed; exact parameter values and timing are not replay guarantees.

environment_measured.gpu_hardware_note: Parent's separately verified nvidia-smi readout reports RTX 5000 Ada Laptop about16 GiB; this child did not rerun nvidia-smi.

benchmark_limitations: First-call initialization is included in INITIAL, especially the first jacrev call; use WARMED for per-step comparisons.
WARMED kernel uses repeated actual Jacobian at a single condition, not a separately trained three-condition model; timing only.
ED_first2_s requests eigenvalues0 and1 only; it does not measure full eigensystem cost used by current evaluation.
Matrix-free action was implemented inline for the microbenchmark and checked with np.allclose(atol=1e-12); it is not added to tracked source.
No full SR optimization, CUDA run, sampling implementation or new physical result was produced.
